name: Arabayona de Mógica (Spain)
description: Square flag vertically divided white and blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Arabayona de Mógica (a bridge above waves on blue and a plant on white).
history: Municipal flag of Arabayona de Mógica; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Arabayona de Mógica arms — bridge above waves on blue and plant on white
